task: Figure out which parent-teacher conference slots to book first, before registration opens, based on how the kids are doing in school.
transcript: Opened the app: a Home screen saying 'What can I help with?' with example prompts and a note that nothing is sent without my OK.
Typed 'Which parent-teacher conference slots should I book first for Rafi, Ezra and Noa, before registration opens? Base it on how each kid is doing in school.' and tapped Send.
After 30s the list showed two items for my one question: 'Book parent-teacher slots for Rafi, Ezra and Noa' and 'Choose school conference slots for the kids', both 'Working on it'.

After another minute the list filled with things I never asked for (benefits enrollment, Hudson Prep application, Ezra's missing schoolwork, school forms, family calendar, dinners) and my two items were pushed off the screen.
Scrolled up and down to find my question again; found 'Book parent-teacher slots for Rafi, Ezra and Noa' marked Ready near the bottom, under 'Never miss a school form'.

Tapped it: it said the sign-up opening Sun Nov 15 at 7pm is Lincoln's, so only for Ezra; book Mr. Brandt (Math, C+ with 3 missing assignments) first, then Mr. Ruiz (Science, B, lab report due Mon Nov 16 not in), and Ms. Okafor (A-) and Ms. Hale (A) only if slots remain; up to four 10-minute slots.

Same answer: Rafi has no Maple sign-up yet, ask for Ms. Ortiz when it comes (reading a bit below grade level, 2 reading logs missing). Noa: it couldn't find her school or grades and asked me to tell it.
It offered a reminder a few minutes before 7pm Sunday; I typed 'yes please remind me' and sent.
Waited about 3 minutes with 'Working on it'; then it said 'Done. I'll remind you Sun Nov 15 at 6:50pm' and that the reminder lists Mr. Brandt then Mr. Ruiz.

Went back to the list: the second item 'Choose school conference slots for the kids' was still 'Working on it' after 7 minutes; opening it showed only 'Your family school helper is on it', Change, Details, and dots.
stumbles: My one question turned into two items with different names; one answered, the other still said 'Working on it' after 7 minutes with nothing inside.

Six other items I never asked for (benefits, Hudson Prep, dinners, calendar, school forms, missing schoolwork) appeared and pushed my question off the screen, so I had to scroll around to find my answer.
My answer did not open on its own; I had to spot it in the list and tap it.
The reminder reply took about 3 minutes; ChatGPT would answer in seconds.
'Details' and 'Change' links next to the answer were not explained; I left them alone.
verdict: The answer itself was great: it knew only Ezra's school opens Sunday at 7pm, put the Math teacher first because of the C+ and missing work, explained Rafi and admitted it had nothing on Noa, then set a reminder for 6:50pm. Finding that answer was harder than ChatGPT because a duplicate item and a pile of things I never asked for buried it in the list.
